authority_contract.gcl10_11: Adventure structures and Session kits remain reusable proposal inputs; GCL-12 composes campaign-scale preparation without creating Adventure, Campaign, Scene or Session truth.
authority_contract.f005: Campaign, Scene, Session, membership, Character-control, launch snapshot, Event and projection authority remain MV-IA-F005/A5. GCL-12 creates no live Campaign state and performs no launch.
authority_contract.csw05: Plot/Adventure/Narrative Lab remains pre-authoritative; campaign architecture may reference authorized planning context but cannot incorporate it automatically.
authority_contract.d28: Adventure identities and governed Adventure truth remain D28 authority.
authority_contract.world_reality: World, Reality, Branch, canon, history, timeline and promoted setting truth remain with their owning world/reality authorities. GCL-12 supplies structure only.
authority_contract.time_travel: Time-travel architecture cannot invent causality, paradox, branching, rewrite or temporal-resolution mechanics; it consumes only governed rules when present.
authority_contract.multiversal: Multiversal architecture cannot create Reality/World/Branch identities or assert cross-reality compatibility merely by template composition.
authority_contract.asynchronous: Asynchronous architecture is a preparation pattern only; it does not schedule people, grant membership/control, append Events or create authoritative persistent state.
authority_contract.cozy_mercantile_settlement: Cozy, mercantile and settlement campaigns may propose rhythms/projects but do not mutate economy, market, relationship, settlement or world-state systems.
authority_contract.ai: Optional proposal-only and authorization-filtered; no auto-launch/directing, hidden-context access, canon promotion or world-state mutation.
